details: CIP Safety Point-to-Point Engine (W229) verified cleanly (9/9 stages passed).

standards: ODVA CIP Networks Library Volume 5 (CIP Safety)

stages.details: Class 0x39, 0x3A, 0x3B, SNN (6 octets), SCID (0x20261006), point-to-point mode, nominal EPI 10ms, watchdog 30ms verified.
POU 'CipSafetyPointToPointSync' validated clean with STParser & SecurityGuard; all 10 registers bound.
Anti-ladder security guard intercepted 3/3 prohibited ladder constructs with LadderForbiddenError.
Point-to-point originator (100) to target (200) bound with matching SNN; healthy OPERATIONAL state verified.
Channel A / Channel B complement parity and CRC-S1/CRC-S2 verified; 0xE803 discrepancy fault caught.
Silence monitored; exceeding 30.0 ms watchdog injected 0xE802 and asserted %M444 safe state.
0xE801 SNN mismatch and 0xE804 CRC corruption injected; %M444 safe state asserted, clean recovery verified.
Bit-exact synchronization of %R1900..%R1907 and %M443..%M444 verified with signed/unsigned masking.
100 deterministic scan cycles completed cleanly. Heap growth: 3.72 KB (< 100 KB), Peak cycle latency: 6.81 ms (< 50 ms), Mean cycle latency: 1.75 ms.
